verdict.rationale: Visa publishes an official MCP server: its corporate announcement says developers can connect to Visa Intelligent Commerce APIs through it, and the Visa Acceptance Agent Toolkit documents MCP server access. A live probe confirms the server package (@visaacceptance/mcp) is on npm and maintained by Visa staff. missing for 10: documented MCP tool coverage of the Intelligent Commerce APIs themselves (the toolkit docs describe only Pay by Link and Invoicing tools), detailed setup docs for the Intelligent Commerce MCP endpoint, and independent hands-on reports of connecting an agent (the package is also still pre-1.0).
